sharingCriteriaRules.description: Read-only visibility of all Bookings to the Sales Head role and subordinates. Filter on Booking_Date__c (a required Date field) effectively matches every Booking; refine to per-project scope in a later epic when dashboards land.
sharingCriteriaRules.label: Bookings To Sales Head

sharingCriteriaRules.description: Read-only visibility of CP-sourced Bookings to the CP Manager role and subordinates, for commission attribution oversight. Filters on Source_Channel__c=CP (Picklist) instead of the Lookup Source_CP__c, since Lookup-to-Account fields are rejected by sharing rule criteria.
sharingCriteriaRules.label: CP-Sourced Bookings To CP Manager
